title: Convergence of company profitability
statement: The development–ROA gap narrows over time.
effect_unit: pp ROA per +1 SD development per year (development × time)
notes: Primary: the development slope changes by -0.05 pp per +1 SD per year (from -1.00 in 2022 to -1.22 in 2025), wild p = 0.471, 34 countries, 10,129 company-years.
Robustness: predicted sign in 0% of seven samples. ESEF 2018–2025: +0.06 pp per year (wild p = 0.893), same direction.
σ-convergence: SD of country median ROA 1.36 in 2022 vs 1.29 in 2025.
β-convergence of GDP per person 2012–2024: slope -1.01 (ρ = -0.32, permutation p = 0.075, n = 34); EU only ρ = -0.68 (p = 0.002).
